verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API that can access, create and manipulate content, covering reads and writes of objects, properties, block content and daily notes. It backs this with a published OpenAPI 3.0 spec, an interactive reference, a TypeScript SDK, and an official MCP server plus Chat Connectors for Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT. Those connector docs explicitly expect external assistants to change notes, with Version history offered to restore earlier versions. The docs.capacities.io OpenAPI probe 404s do not contradict this, because the spec is published at api.capacities.io. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent read/write workflows, and clarity on migration from the Beta API (sunsetting September 1, 2026) to the new API.
